# agentic-notify

Notifications for humans and agents: in-app inbox, email and webhook delivery.

- SDK: import { createClient } from "agentic-notify/sdk".
- CLI: npx agentic-notify --help.
- MCP: npx agentic-notify mcp, then call list_notifications.
- UI (React): import { NotificationBell } from "agentic-notify/ui"; also import "agentic-design/styles.css" and "agentic-notify/ui.css". Props: baseUrl, getToken, pollMs, limit. Also useNotifications, Inbox, mount(element, options).

## Docs

- README: https://github.com/pooriaarab/agentic-notify
